title: Piece
description: Serialized form of a Piece (a full transcription). The raga here is the SOURCE of the (stratifiedRatios, fundamental) context threaded down phraseGrid -> phrase -> trajectory -> pitch on load. CANONICAL form omits durArray, sectionCategorization, sectionStarts, sectionStartsGrid, and phrases (all derivable). durArrayGrid[0]/sectionCatGrid[0]/phraseGrid[0] are the sources of truth.

phraseGrid.description: Per-instrument grid of phrases: phraseGrid[track][i] = Phrase.
